title: Order lookup builds SQL by interpolating a request value
description: The insecure Web lab assembles the order query with string interpolation of a request-derived customer identifier, so a crafted value alters the query rather than being treated as data.
root_cause: The repository layer concatenates input into SQL instead of using a parameterised statement, so no trust boundary separates data from query structure.
impact: A synthetic canary record belonging to another customer was read. Proof stopped at the seeded canary; no dataset was enumerated.

priority.rationale: High technical impact and high confidence on a lab-reachable asset, with no compensating control in the insecure target.

remediation.direction: Replace interpolation with a parameterised statement and add an architecture rule rejecting raw SQL assembly at the trust boundary.

audit.reason: Occurrence ingested from a scoped run.
Asset confirmed in scope and result reproduced manually.
Root cause, impact and redacted canary evidence recorded.
Parameterised statement implemented in the secure target.
Candidate fix merged and the protected pipeline passed.
Independent retest against the named artifact; the original proof no longer succeeds.
